ciFast.note: Fast verification will confirm the semantic replays, full test suite, build, and bundle gates after the coherent release branch is pushed.

ciDeep.note: This bounded compiler-quality release does not claim a trained adapter, held-out full-course win, paid-reference parity, or new device result.

deploy.note: The release will deploy from the merged main commit after required verification succeeds.

liveProvider.note: The replays use retained source-grounded artifacts and make no fresh provider or model call.

manualHuman.note: No human or instructor judgment is claimed; retained preference evidence comes from one identified Codex judge in two presentation orders.

strictLayeredEvaluation.note: The main layered evaluation passes all 40 compiler-contract fixtures, the evidence-aware benchmark, and retained production canaries. The release claim remains limited to conservative interception of twelve previously judged Scion losses with zero model-text mutation; it does not prove that remaining outputs are factually correct or that an adapter beats base Scion.

claims.summary: Across all 46 stable paired-order Scion losses, interception rises from nine to twelve and answer-index repair rises from three to six while regeneration rejects remain six.
Three additional keys are repaired only from unique first-sentence lexical evidence with a two-token floor, positive margin, conservative morphology, and complete provenance.
Literal labels, generic correct-choice prose, negative or misconception sentences, tied options, weak paraphrases, and the measured ambiguous UX case refuse lexical repair.

The retained-source replay records 57 key repairs versus 52 while keeping 141/192 admission, 51/192 burden, and zero response mutations; five weak deterministic training pairs are quarantined, reducing usable rows from 123 to 118.
Thirty-four stable losses remain unresolved, only 46 of 100 required judge preferences exist, and no quality adapter is trained, active, or promoted.
